g.text: Chen Notation | Rectangles: Entities | Diamonds: Relationships | Ellipses: Attributes | Underlined: Primary Key
Academic ER Notation Legend (Chen Model & Participation Semantics)
Independent entity with intrinsic primary key
Existence-dependent entity; requires parent PK + Partial Key
Binary relationship between strong entities (1:1, 1:N, M:N)
Identifies weak entity to parent owner
Partial discriminator key of weak entity (Dashed underline)
Decomposable into sub-attributes (e.g. Name -> First, Last)
Total Participation (Double Line) — Every entity instance MUST participate
Partial Participation (Single Line) — Participation is optional
